final: WITH c AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS cnt FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), s AS (SELECT sex, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share, (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM c) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
